name: bran
description: Compile and audit executable branching-story packages for replayable multi-seat AI games.

interface.shortDescription: Compile and validate branching story packages
interface.longDescription: Turn source material and world rules into validated branching-story packages with typed actions, multi-seat visibility, replay variants, Agent information-gain tests, carryover consequences, deterministic settlement, and reproducible receipts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $bran to compile and validate this executable branching story package.
